title: Answer
description:
The one who is sent and the one who is appointed meet in a single title. Neither commission alone is that title.

The comparison is not an attack on the servant. It was first a defence of him, and he remains faithful inside the house. The Son is over it.

The house is what the son of David builds and what the Branch builds while he is priest on the throne. Being that house was conditional for a people already brought out.
